0022600015.text: The Charlotte Hornets (3-2, 1st in the Southeast, 5th in the East) head to Washington for their sixth game of the season, in East Group C of the Emirates NBA Cup, after a one-game losing streak, while the Wizards (2-3, 3rd in the Southeast, 1 game back, 9th in the East) have dropped two straight. Charlotte is missing Coby White, Grant Williams, Kon Knueppel and Kylan Boswell, and Washington is without Jamir Watkins, Justin Champagnie and Tristan Vukcevic. The Hornets lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 110-103 win in Charlotte on Oct. 26, and they also won all four meetings in 2025-26 by a 4-0 margin.
